title: Owned LDAP Identity authorization at the Grid service boundary
summary: The Grid read-only service can consume an already attributed principal and Identity Directory ACL decision without implementing LDAP protocol/authentication or absorbing directory authority.
invariants: LDAP Bind, SASL, TLS, Secret Broker and credential verification remain in the owned LDAP Identity service; the Grid adapter accepts only an attributed principal identifier.
Authentication attribution is not authorization. IdentityDirectory aclDecision is consulted for the exact Grid service action.
The Grid service directory resource type is REXXOS_GRID and its semantic resource reference is rexxos://<GRID_ID>/service/rexxos.grid/0.1.
GRID.ESTATE.READ and GRID.MANAGEMENT.READ are explicit actions; no wildcard administrator role is invented by the Grid.
Missing principal attribution fails UNAUTHENTICATED; an absent or denied directory ACL fails PERMISSION_DENIED.

Authorization evidence is fenced to directory, principal and resource revisions and grants only service access. It does not grant placement, WLU, Storage, Memory, XTP routing, economic or failover authority.
ConnectSelector remains connector authority and RpcServiceCore/serialization boundaries remain unchanged.
procedure: Authenticate through an approved owned identity path and obtain the attributed principal.
Resolve the exact REXXOS_GRID service resource in Identity Directory.
Evaluate the exact ACL action and fail closed on missing, inactive or denied principal/resource state.
Only after an allowed decision invoke the existing explicit read-only Grid RpcServiceCore operation.

provenance.claim: Identity Directory ACL authorization evidence and revision fencing
Neutral identity, resource and ACL authority consumed by the Grid seam
